title: Development Tribunal decision 22-012: alterations to a Class 7b tenancy; hydrants and fire detection disputed under NCC 2019 Amendment 1 (Portsmith, Cairns)
jurisdiction: Queensland, Australia. COMPARATIVE TEST ONLY: not Alberta; no Alberta applicability asserted.
document_type: Development Tribunal decision notice (Planning Act 2016 s 255), Queensland
document_date: Decision notice dated 9 Apr 2024 (PDF p. 11); hearing 8 Jul 2022 (p. 1); assessment manager's approval dated 14 Mar 2022 (p. 2)

facts.text: QFES, as building advisory agency, appealed under Planning Act 2016 s 229(1)(a)(ii) a development approval for building work for alterations to an existing tenancy at Portsmith, Cairns.

The tribunal recorded that the subject site is a Class 7b building of Type C construction, assessed against BCA 2019 Amendment 1, and that the application involved bringing the building back into BCA compliance.

QFES's recorded points: internal hydrant locations did not meet QFES operational requirements; the hydrant booster system did not comply with AS 2419.1; the proposed fire detection and alarm system did not comply with the NCC.
The tribunal set aside the approval dated 14 Mar 2022 and ordered the assessment manager to remake the decision having regard to A2.2(3) of NCC 2019 Amendment 1.
The notice discusses an existing hydrant booster system treated as lawful existing, and refers to s 68 of the Building Act 1975 for hydrant matters.
